bundle.shortDescription: Photorealistic 3D mockups of packaging, books, print and devices
bundle.longDescription: Mockup Director turns flat artwork into photorealistic 3D mockups with lighting, soft shadows and reflections: product boxes, DVD / Blu-ray / CD cases and discs, books and notebooks, print (business cards, flyers, brochures, cards) and devices and screens. Export to PNG/JPEG/WebP up to 4000 × 4000 px, GIF/WebP/MP4 animations and batch export to ZIP.
